question: Born on ____________, Mohandas Karamchand Gandhi whose birthday is celebrated as Gandhi Jayanti, successfully led India’s non-violence movement against the British.
solution:
The correct answer is** 2 October 1869**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mohandas Karamchand Gandhi**, commonly known as Mahatma Gandhi, was born on **Sat Oct 02 1869**.
 
• His birthday is celebrated annually as **Gandhi Jayanti** in India.
 
• Gandhi is renowned for leading India's **non-violence movement** against British colonial rule.
 
• His philosophy and methods of **non-violent resistance** have inspired movements for civil rights and freedom across the world.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Gandhi's principles of **truth and non-violence (Satyagraha and Ahimsa)** played a crucial role in the Indian independence movement.
 
• He is often referred to as the **"Father of the Nation"** in India for his pivotal role in the country's struggle for independence.
 
• **Gandhi Jayanti** is observed as a national holiday in India and is also marked as the **International Day of Non-Violence** by the United Nations.
 
• Gandhi's life and teachings continue to influence global peace and civil rights movements.
